newsitem.title: USA: ELXSI Corp stake held by Kellogg group.
newsitem.headline: ELXSI Corp stake held by Kellogg group.

text.p: A group led by Peter Kellogg, an investor, said Thursday it holds a 7.69 percent stake in ELXSI Corp or 368,500 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 138,500 additional common bought between November 23 and December 12 at prices ranging from $5.125 to $5.375 per share.
The stake is held for investment purposes, the group said in the filing.
The Greenwich, Conn., company is involved in identification and acquisition of operating companies and currently owns a chain of restaurants.
